# FERROGRID — The Ferro Crete Developers

> FERROGRID is a ferrocement construction company based in Sultan Bathery, Wayanad, Kerala, India, with 26+ years of experience and 50+ projects built. It designs and builds ferrocement swimming pools, resort cottages and dome houses, underground houses and cave huts, eco-friendly huts, farm stay buildings and water features (waterfalls, grottos, rock art) for resorts, homestays and property developers.

## Services

- [Swimming Pools](https://ferrogrid.in/service-swimming-pools.html): A ferrocement swimming pool is a pool whose shell is built from layers of closely spaced steel wire mesh, filled and covered with rich cement mortar. The result is a thin, seamless and watertight shell that can follow almost any shape — freeform, kidney or infinity-edge — with fewer joints than a conventional concrete pool.
- [Resort Cottages](https://ferrogrid.in/service-resort-cottages.html): Ferrocement resort cottages are guest rooms built as thin, curved shells of cement mortar over layers of steel mesh. Because the mesh can be shaped freely, cottages can be domes, caves, pods or organic forms with green roofs — giving a resort a signature look while staying durable, weather-resistant and economical to build.
- [Eco-Friendly Huts](https://ferrogrid.in/service-eco-friendly-huts.html): Ferrocement huts are thin shells of cement mortar over steel mesh, so they use less cement and steel than conventional walls and roofs. They can be shaped into domes and earth-covered pods, topped with grass, and fitted onto slopes and forest sites — making them economical, durable and gentle on the land.
- [Underground Houses](https://ferrogrid.in/service-underground-houses.html): Ferrocement is well suited to underground houses and cave huts because its curved, arched shells carry the weight of earth efficiently, and its dense, mesh-reinforced walls resist moisture. FERROGRID builds underground cave houses, earth-sheltered cottages, cellars and underground auditoriums for resorts and homestays.
- [Farm Stay Buildings](https://ferrogrid.in/service-farm-stay-buildings.html): Ferrocement suits most farm and plantation buildings: farm stay guest cottages, vaulted cattle sheds, water storage tanks, rainwater harvesting systems and biogas plants. Its dense, mesh-reinforced shells stand up to monsoon rain and heat, need little maintenance and are economical to build.
- [Water Features](https://ferrogrid.in/service-water-features.html): Artificial waterfalls and rock grottos are built in ferrocement: a steel frame and wire mesh set the shape, then cement mortar is applied and hand-sculpted to look like natural rock. The basins are seamless and watertight, so water features hold water and weather naturally over time.
